audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was dismissed as 'far too slow to set up in a 1v1'. The real limiter is range, not speed.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80s at only 410 range and it launches enemies toward the Ball. In lane it drags you back to where the ball sits — that is a position problem for you, and the ball's location is the thing to track.
audit.corrected: Range and effect stated in whys[4], spikes[1], dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. spikes[2] used a fabricated ability name, 'Command: Shield'. The early text called Clockwork Windup a 'passive shield' that 'only absorbs one instance of burst'.
audit.why: The shield is Command: Protect (E) — a flat 9-second cooldown that also grants armour and magic resist to whoever the Ball attaches to. Clockwork Windup is bonus on-hit magic damage that ramps on a repeated target; it absorbs nothing. Command: Protect on a flat 9s is the interaction that actually changes the all-in maths, and it was never costed.
audit.corrected: Real names and the 9-second cooldown written into spikes[2], early, dosFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Command: Attack's cooldown was never given.
audit.why: 7s at rank 1 falling to 3s at rank 5 means her poke is effectively always up — there is no Q window to step into, which changes what 'wait for the cooldown' means in this lane.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding and dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: Orianna's Ball gives her poke and a shield, but she has no dash and no way to escape a committed dive once you're in melee range. At levels 1-2 you can punish her whenever she's forced to auto-attack for CS with Ball out of position, since her passive shield only absorbs one instance of burst. She has to play at max range just to trade evenly, ceding you lane priority.
edits.after: Orianna's Ball gives her poke and a shield, but she has no dash and no way to escape a committed dive once you're in melee range. At levels 1-2 punish her whenever she has to auto-attack for CS with the ball out of position — Clockwork Windup is bonus on-hit magic damage, not a shield, and Command: Protect has to be pulled home before it saves her. She plays at max range just to trade evenly, ceding you priority.

notes: Two real fabrications fixed: 'Command: Shield' in spikes[2] (the ability is Command: Protect) and the claim in early that Orianna's passive is a shield absorbing one instance of burst (Clockwork Windup is ramping on-hit magic damage). The suspectNames hit on 'Hold Shockwave' was a shorthand rather than a wrong name, but I expanded it to Command: Shockwave anyway. Same inherited build contradiction as the rest of the Irelia set: content spikes[3] and late are written around Trinity Force while report[8] prescribes Blade of the Ruined King into Wit's End. I removed the Trinity reference from spikes[2] and whys[5] where it was incidental, but left spikes[3] and late alone because the whole sentence is built on it and I cannot tell which build the page intends. Not verified from the kits: whether the Command: Shockwave pull can be dodged by Irelia's Bladesurge during its delay, and whether tenacity shortens the displacement.
